ios.desc:
Folocard is a fresh approach to in-person business networking, ideal for conferences and meetups.

How it works:

1. Scan a business card (we grab email)
2. Send follow up email (we plug email into a template).
3. Repeat 1 + 2 until you finish your stack.

COMPOSE unlimited email templates for any scenario.
EDIT your draft email before sending by personalizing or contextualizing.

Business card reader apps have been focused on contact management and digital Rolodex. Also, business card scanner apps that offer social networking functionality are limited to the userbase of that particular app. This siloed approach totally misses the point of the business card. A social contract saying: CONTACT ME!

So...we made it very fast and simple to do that.

User testing shows that immediately following up provides a positive impression on new contacts that leads to shorter sales cycles and even repeat meetings at conferences, tradeshows & exhibitions. Go from field MQLs to SQLs faster.

Growth hack your leads pipeline by capturing leads, tracking prospects and engaging customers. By accelerating the business relationship in a streamlined workflow that drives rapid response & RESULTS. A lead gen and networking supertool.

BASIC features:

* FREE: Unlimited Scans. Unlike other apps, we offer a free business card scanner. 

* EXTRA FREE: Unlimited Templates. Prepare different email templates for different scenarios. From personal to different business events and context. Example: Real Estate agents prepare templates per property.

* FREE EXPORT: Save to .CSV

* PERSONALIZE: Add the first name dynamically from the scan result: "Hey Steve!"

* IMPORT: Access your photo gallery to scan any image.

* OFFLINE: No WiFI / Cellular reception in a conference, no problem. Enabled Airplane mode? Pull out those business cards to complete your follow-ups before you land. Your email app will queue them. Your next Monday back at the office will be a very different experience.

* SAVE: Automatically add contacts after the follow-up, to your device.

* ATTACHMENTS: Add the scanned business card as an image to the template. Also, you can append TXT files of the OCR (scanned) results, or even embed in the email (helps with search). 

* LOCATION: Get context by tagging the GPS location of your scan. You can also embed the exact location into the email body dynamically with a Macro. Aka, we 'met' here...

* ANYONE: LONG PRESS the capture button to launch a simple email field form. This is us

android.desc:
Turn business cards into reviewed contacts and follow-up drafts you control.

Folocard is a business card scanner, contact manager, and first-touch mini CRM for the moment after you meet someone. Capture the card, review the details, keep the context together, and prepare the next action while the conversation is still fresh.

SCAN BUSINESS CARDS

- Capture one card or keep the camera open for a batch.
- Use on-device text recognition to find names, job titles, companies, email addresses, phone numbers, and websites.
- Review uncertain fields before you use them.
- Optionally use a compatible local AI model to help repair difficult scans.

ORGANIZE NEW CONTACTS

- Keep each person, card evidence, draft status, and next action together in a first-touch thread.
- Use the review queue to find contacts that still need attention.
- Check scan-session progress and statistics after a networking event or card-scanning session.
- Export a contact as vCard or export your card list as CSV when you choose.

PREPARE THE FOLLOW-UP

- Create a follow-up draft from contact details and context stored on your device.
- Review and edit the message before taking action.
- Open the draft in your email app when you are ready.
- Folocard prepares the message; you decide what gets sent.

USE OPTIONAL LOCAL AI

- Download and manage compatible local models in the app.
- Use a local model for private on-device chat and difficult-card repair.
- Card capture and review work without an AI model.

KEEP CONTROL OF YOUR DATA

- Core scanning, contact storage, review, and drafting are designed to run locally.
- No DataXad account is required for the local Android experience.
- Model downloads and user-directed external actions use the internet and are explained in the app and privacy policy.

Folocard is built for networking, conferences, trade shows, lead capture, field sales, real-estate meetings, contractor visits, and any first meeting that deserves a thoughtful next step.

Folocard focuses on first-touch capture and preparation. It does not manage a full sales pipeline or send messages automatically.

AI output can be incomplete or wrong. Review contact details and drafts before using or sharing them.

quotes.text:
Folocard is a side project that grew up.

We think of it as the 1st follow up app.

It's designed to be a simple autoresponder for when you meet new people.

Here is how it works:

1. Prepare an email templates
2. Scan business card
3. Get a draft ready to send

You can scan anything to find an email address (even handwritten works!). 
You don't have to send the email right away, I sometimes use the draft folder as a todo list.

The idea was born from my experience going to large conferences (CES, MWC, etc..) and getting hundreds of business cards. I would never fully get around to following up with everyone for different reasons. Yet the business card scanner apps out there are either limited or paid, and they just capture the data (digital rolodex). It's the follow-up action that is missing.

I know people here don't like business cards, I sympathize. But others do, and you can scan the cards and give'em back. Also if you meet someone without a business card give the scan button a long press ;)

Happy to get some feedback.

I'm curious to know peoples follow up methods, and what email templates you think are useful (I once thought to include a 'complaint' template for restaurants - "I want to speak with your manager").
